component_guidelines.sidebar: Fixed or sticky left navigation bar containing Logo, Nav links with active states (Dashboard, My Profile, Find Jobs, Saved Jobs, Applications, Interviews), Nurse Quick Status summary at bottom.
component_guidelines.topbar: Contains Search trigger / Mobile hamburger trigger, Notification Bell with unread counter badge, Theme toggle (Light/Dark), Nurse Avatar + Name dropdown (View Profile, Settings, Logout).
component_guidelines.stat_cards: Bento-style metrics cards for: Profile Completion %, Verification Status Badge, Saved Jobs Count, Active Applications Count, Shortlisted Count, Upcoming Interviews Count. Includes trend/action callouts.
component_guidelines.profile_summary_card: Hero banner with avatar, nurse name, specialty badge (e.g. ICU RN / BSN), license ID, verification badge (Verified / Pending / Under Review / Rejected), completion progress bar, quick edit action.
component_guidelines.job_card: Clean card with hospital name, logo/avatar, job title, department, shift type, location, pay rate ($/hr or annual), transparent rule-based match % badge (e.g., 92% Match with Breakdown tooltip), Save button, Quick Apply button.
component_guidelines.application_tracker_stepper: Visual horizontal / vertical step tracker: Applied → Under Review → Shortlisted → Interview Scheduled → Selected (or Rejected / Withdrawn pill status).
component_guidelines.interview_card: Divided into 'Upcoming Interviews' and 'Past Interviews' tabs/sections. Displays date, time, interview type (Video / In-Person), hospital name, interviewer info, join link or location details, preparation notes.
component_guidelines.filter_panel: Sticky filter panel for Job Search with filters: Title / Keyword, Department, Qualification (RN, BSN, MSN, NP), Location, Salary Range, Experience Level, Shift Preference (Day/Night/PRN), Accommodation Provided toggle.
component_guidelines.profile_edit_form: Multi-tab or segmented edit page: Personal Info, Professional Info & Experience, Shift & Location Preferences, Document Upload (RN License, BLS/ACLS Certifications, Resume/CV, Immunization records) with status badges and re-upload capabilities.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application renders seamlessly on all viewports with responsive sidebar toggles.
Implement Lucide icons (`lucide-react`) for clean clinical UI indicators (Stethoscope, ShieldCheck, Clock, MapPin, DollarSign, Calendar, FileText, Bookmark, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle).
Use Framer Motion or pure Tailwind transitions for tab changes and step tracker animations without heavy distraction.
Support Light and Dark mode using Tailwind class-based dark mode toggle.
Provide empty states with clear CTAs (e.g. 'No Saved Jobs Yet - Find Jobs Now') when data arrays are empty.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes adhering to test guidelines.
Provide rich realistic mock data fallback when backend FastAPI endpoints return empty lists or loading states.
